# Corrie Stein

Corrie Stein is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 1981.

Corrie Stein has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2002 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/corrie-stein#e2)

  Not elected.

Links for Corrie Stein:

- Wikipedia : [Corrie\_Stein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corrie_Stein)
